snippets.snippet: CITY OF LA GRANGE, KENTUCKY ORDINANCE NO. 5, SERIES 2026 AN ORDINANCE AMENDING SIGN REGULATIONS WHEREAS, the city council desires to amend the regulations relating to temporary signs currently incorporated by reference to Sec. 290-120 of the Oldham County Comprehensive Zoning Ordinance by La Grange Ordinance Code Sec. 153.01. NOW THEREFORE, BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LA GRANGE, KENTUCKY: A new sub-section of Section 153.02 of the La Grange Ordinance Code, shall read as follows: Temporary free-standing signs of twelve square feet or less do not require a sign permit.
